detail.title: Dahua 8MP 5G Vari-focal Bullet WizMind Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-HFW5842DK1-Z-5G Dahua 8MP 5G Vari-focal Bullet WizMind Network Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 8MP Resolution • SA/NSA/LTE-TDD/LTE-FDD/WCDMA 5G wireless network transmission, support Micro SIM card • Supports Over 5 AI Functions, Applicable for Multi-scenario Targets Detection and Analysis • Built-in Mic & Speaker: Secure Real-Time Talk • IP67 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: 0.005 lux@F1.8 (Color, 30 IRE) 0.0005 lux@F1.8 (B/W, 30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.Illumination Distance: Up to 60 m (196.85 ft) (IR) Up to 40 m (131.23 ft) (Warm light)
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, tripwire, fast moving (the three functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human); loitering detection, people gathering, and parking detection
General.Smart Object Detection: Smart abandoned object; smart missing object
General.Face Detection: Face detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes (gender, age, glasses, expressions, mask, and beard) and 8 expressions (angry, sad, disgusted, scared, surprised, calm, happy, confused); face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot); face angle filter; optimization time setting
General.People Counting: Tripwire people counting and people counting in area, queue management; 4 rules can be set for tripwire, people counting in area and queue management
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by the sub stream)
General.AI Coding: AI H.265 (Compression rate≥25%) AI H.264 (Compression rate≥25%)
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 3840 × 2160@(1–25/30 fps) sub stream: D1@(1–25/30 fps) third stream: 1080p@(1–25/30 fps) *The values above are the max. frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 3 kbps–8192 kbps H.265: 3 kbps–8192 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; tripwire; intrusion; fast moving; abandoned object; missing object; loitering detection; people gathering; scene changing; audio detection; voltage detection; external alarm; face detection; security exception
General.Frequency: 5G: SA: N1/N3/N7/N8/N20/N28/N38/N40/N41/N75/N76/ N77/N78 NSA: N1/N3/N7/N8/N20/N28/N38/N40/N41/N77/N78 Applicable regions: Europe, Australia, Middle East, Africa 4G: FDD-LTE: B1/B3 /B7 /B20 TDD-LTE: B41 Applicable regions: Europe, Australia, Middle East, Africa 3G: WCDMA: B1 /B8 Applicable regions: Europe, Australia, Middle East, Africa
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP;TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; PPPoE; SNMP
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S/Profile G/Profile T); CGI; Milestone; P2P
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 512 GB); NAS
General.Browser: IE: IE9 and later Chrome Firefox Safari: Safari 12 and later
General.Certification: CE-LVD: EN62368-1 CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU FCC: 47 CFR FCC Part 15, Subpart B UL/CUL:UL62368-1 & CAN/CSA C22.2 No. 62368-1-14 CE RED
